Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::makeNewOrder(orderid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		newOrder: OrderProduct = self.CurrentOrderProduct
	precondition:
		OrderProduct.allInstances()->forAll(o: OrderProduct|o.Id<>orderid)
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct = newOrder and
		newOrder.oclIsNew() and
		OrderProduct.allInstances()->includes(newOrder) and
		newOrder.Id = orderid and
		newOrder.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::NEW and
		newOrder.Time = Now
}
